# PyBlade

> PyBlade is a lightweight, reactive template engine for Python. It brings an expressive `@`-based template syntax (directives such as `@if`, `@for`, `@extends`, `@component`), reusable components, and server-driven reactivity ("Live Components") to Python web apps using only Python and HTML, without a frontend framework. Inspired by Laravel Blade and Livewire. Django is fully supported today; other frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Starlette, Litestar, Sanic) are covered in the Framework integration page. The project is experimental/beta: APIs may change.

Install: `pip install pyblade` (or `poetry add pyblade` / `uv add pyblade`). Verify with `pyblade -v`.
Source: https://github.com/AntaresMugisho/pyblade | Docs: https://docs.pyblade.com | Feedback: https://feedback.pyblade.com
